findings.title: R166-to-C84 courtyard gap stated as 0.56 mm; the board gives 0.65 mm (centreline) / 0.60 mm (stroke outer edges); the same R10_VALIDATION row says ORDERING asks for a top-side preheat, which it does not
findings.contradicts: docs/ORDERING.md §8.2 line 435 ('on the top R166's courtyard is 0.56 mm from C84's'); docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 3063 ('R166, 0.56 mm from its courtyard ... the same on a0ec075e…'; also 'ORDERING 8.2 ... asks for top-side preheat with the bottom supported') and line 1685 (R19-MEC-02 row, 'R166 is 0.56 mm away'). The figure is checked against the board (a0ec075e…) and the footprint libraries.
findings.evidence: Footprint primitives: kilib/rocket.pretty/M3_MA_8x10.kicad_mod F.CrtYd rect (-5.25,-4.5)-(5.25,4.5), stroke 0.05; C84 at F(27.5,78.5) rot 90, so its courtyard runs y 73.25-83.75. kilib/rocket.pretty/M3_R2512_UR.kicad_mod F.CrtYd rect (-4.35,-1.9)-(4.35,1.9), stroke 0.05; R166 at F(23.5,86.3) rot 0, so y 84.40-88.20, x 19.15-27.85 (overlaps C84's x 23.0-32.0). Gap: 84.40-83.75 = 0.650 mm centreline; 84.375-83.775 = 0.600 mm between the stroke outer edges. KiCad's own courtyard polygon (FOOTPRINT.GetCourtyard(F_CrtYd)) has vertices at y 83.745 (C84) and 84.405 (R166); the project's helper check_r8.min_gap(check_r8.courtyard(C84), check_r8.courtyard(R166)) returns 0.66 mm. The 0.56 mm comes only from SHAPE_POLY_SET.BBox(), which pads each box by 0.045 mm (C84 BBox bottom 83.795, R166 BBox top 84.355). Those are the exact inputs round28_audit_proc.md row 3 quotes ('C84 courtyard y <= 83.795 and R166 courtyard y >= 84.355: 0.56 mm'), so the figure is a bounding-box artefact, not a gap. None of the three conventions (centreline, outer edge, KiCad polygon) gives 0.56; the error is 0.04-0.10 mm, about 7-18 %, which is not rounding. Second point: ORDERING 8.2's heat-limit text says to support the bottom face, 'heat only from the top' with minimum dwell, and 'Record the tip temperature and time used'. It never asks for a preheat, so R10_VALIDATION line 3063's 'asks for top-side preheat' describes a step that ORDERING does not contain. Probe: .supervisor/r32_manufacturing/dist.py, claims.py and the inline GetCourtyard dump.
findings.impact: The C84 heat-limit records misstate the board geometry. Its direction is conservative (the real gap is larger), and the inspection list (R166 re-inspection) is unaffected. A reader of R10_VALIDATION is told that ORDERING requires a preheat step that the procedure does not define.
findings.concrete_fix: In ORDERING §8.2 (line 435) and R10_VALIDATION line 3063, replace 0.56 mm with 0.65 mm (courtyard centrelines; 0.60 mm between the courtyard lines' outer edges). Annotate the R19-MEC-02 history row (line 1685) with the corrected current figure. In R10_VALIDATION line 3063, replace 'asks for top-side preheat with the bottom supported' with 'asks for top-only heating with the bottom supported on a heat-sinking fixture, a minimum dwell per land and a recorded tip temperature and time'.
